params.1273: Cut a log from a regular tree so you have some wood to work with.
params.1274: Find any regular <col=FFFFFF>tree</col> and click it to start chopping.
params.2225: Cutting a log from a tree earns you Woodcutting XP. The logs you gather can be used to train Firemaking or Fletching. You might want to gather a few more.
